critical_code_review_comments: clients.py and students.py both inline the same user attribution lookup pattern (find users by id list → umap → decorate office_admin docs). Consider extracting to a shared helper like _attach_creator_attribution(docs) in auth_lib.py to avoid drift if more aggregation endpoints are added.

list_clients/list_students issue a second DB query for every super_admin GET. For very large datasets it would be cheaper to $lookup-join via aggregation pipeline, but at current scale (<2000 docs) the two-query approach is acceptable.

Both endpoints rely on user.role == 'office_admin' to decide whether to add the badge. Stale super_admin or deleted users will simply be skipped — fine. Stale users without office field (e.g. legacy ADHISH K JEES) yield _creator_office=None which the UI guards against. Verified empirically.
Students.jsx openAddStudent setForm always seeds reference=''. The picker path then overrides via pickClientAndEnrol. Good — no stale ref leakage.

Office admin's picker filter logic implicitly works because their /clients endpoint already returns staff-only entries (Clients.jsx UI prevents them from creating other types). If that invariant is ever broken, picker would show non-staff to office_admin — consider an explicit client.client_type==='staff' filter in pickerItems for office_admin role as defense-in-depth.
OfficeDashboard add-admission staff-picker → /students?new=1&staff=<name> useEffect bypasses the picker; documented as intentional in iteration_17 review. No change needed.
Native HTML date input still used for Enrollment Date in student form — out of iteration scope but should be migrated to shadcn calendar for consistency.
